offering_description.value: Provides fleet fuel cards, corporate payment solutions and benefits administration platforms. Sells to fleets, businesses, travel and healthcare organizations, and employers. Earns money from payment processing, interchange, interest and software service fees.

primary_products.value: fleet fuel cards; virtual corporate payment cards; health savings account products; consumer-directed benefits software

primary_services.value: payment processing; accounts payable automation; benefits administration; COBRA and billing administration; fleet management data services

customer_segment.value: B2B: fleets, small and mid-size businesses, corporates, travel agencies, employers, health plans; B2C: individual HSA account holders and benefit participants

end_markets.value: transportation and fleet; travel; healthcare benefits; corporate payables; retail fuel

revenue_model.value: transaction or usage fees: payment processing and interchange fees from fuel and purchase card transactions; interest or premiums: interest on receivables, late fees and deposit-related income; service fees: account servicing and benefits administration fees; subscription: software platform fees for benefits administration
revenue_model.category: transaction or usage fees; interest or premiums; service fees; subscription

value_chain_position.value: financial intermediary: issues and processes payments between merchants and fleet/business customers; software / platform: benefits and payment software sold to employers and businesses

geography_served.value: global: United States, Europe, Australia, Asia and Brazil

specialization.value: related lines: fleet payments, corporate payments and benefits solutions sharing payment technology

distribution_channels.value: direct sales: sales teams selling to fleets, corporates and employers; partners / resellers: co-brand partners, oil companies, health plans and software integrators; online: online account signup for small fleets and businesses

regulatory_exposure.value: high: WEX Bank is an industrial bank regulated by FDIC and Utah DFI, HSA custodian and payments rules, CFPB, IRS
